data.title: Monochrome Animelee
data.description:
I received a good response on my monochrome Luigi's, so I figured I'd just do it for the whole cast (except G&W and Kirby for obvious reasons). It should be organized pretty decently and I also included all the textures in case you want some of it and not all? idk.

Let me know if you run into any issues with any of the skins or if you want a specific one tweaked. (I'm not a fan of how the neutral falco/fox look but couldn't really decide what to do for them so. idk let me know I guess.)

Hope you like them
